verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, typed server-side SDKs, CLI, and MCP/AgentOS tooling are adjacent features, not a published API specification. A fintech API platform could plausibly publish one, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
